title: Wild crows inhabiting the city use it to their advantage - David Attenborough  - BBC wildlife
summary: A short BBC clip narrated by David Attenborough showing crows in Japan using city traffic to crack nuts, dropping them at intersections and retrieving them when the light changes.
why: HN uses it as the standard illustration of animal tool use and adaptive intelligence in crow threads.
